en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting tall, thin earth pyramids or rock spires rising from a valley slope. Small human figures at the base emphasize the height of the formations. The title "Piramidi Glaciali di Segonzano" is printed at the top center. On the left margin it reads "N. 1647 – Stab. Art. Fotog. G. Pavanello – Cles" and on the right margin "È proibita la riproduzione". The image has a printed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
